contract: construct() -> 24 coefficients in {+1, -1} of P(z) = sum c_k z^k. The score is max over |z| = 1 of |P(z)| divided by sqrt(24), computed by dense sampling and golden-section refinement of the highest peaks (accuracy about 1e-9). Minimize; the exhaustive optimum is 1.2583758.
